meaning.en: Something that is injected, especially a dose of liquid medicine injected into the body.

meaning.en: An act or instance of injecting.

meaning.en: The definition of an injection is the act of pumping something in, or something that has been pumped in.

meaning.en: Something injected.  A liquid injected into the body. A fuel under pressure forced into a combustion chamber.

meaning.en: Something that is injected, especially a dose of liquid medicine injected into the body.

meaning.en: The act of injecting, or something that is injected.
meaning.vi: Hành động tiêm, hoặc thứ gì đó được tiêm.

meaning.en: (specifically, medicine) Something injected subcutaneously, intravenously, or intramuscularly by use of a syringe and a needle.
meaning.vi: (cụ thể là thuốc) Một thứ gì đó được tiêm dưới da, tiêm tĩnh mạch hoặc tiêm bắp bằng cách sử dụng ống tiêm và kim.

meaning.en: (set theory) A function that maps distinct x in the domain to distinct y in the codomain; formally, a f: X → Y such that f(a) = f(b) implies a = b for any a, b in the domain.
meaning.vi: (lý thuyết tập hợp) Một hàm ánh xạ x phân biệt trong miền với y phân biệt trong miền; về mặt hình thức, af: X → Y sao cho f (a) = f (b) ngụ ý a = b với a, b bất kỳ trong miền.

meaning.en: (mathematics) A relation on sets (X,Y) that associates each element of Y with at most one element of X.
meaning.vi: (toán học) Một quan hệ trên các tập hợp (X, Y) liên kết mỗi phần tử của Y với nhiều nhất một phần tử của X.

meaning.en: (figuratively) The addition of money to someone, or to a business.
meaning.vi: (nghĩa bóng) Việc bổ sung tiền cho một người nào đó, hoặc cho một doanh nghiệp.

meaning.en: (programming) The insertion of program code into an application, URL, hardware, etc.
meaning.vi: (lập trình) Việc chèn mã chương trình vào ứng dụng, URL, phần cứng, v.v.
Một bệnh phẩm được chuẩn bị bằng cách tiêm.

meaning.en: (steam engines) The act of throwing cold water into a condenser to produce a vacuum.

sentences.en: The animal, after injection, must be kept in favourable surroundings, and any resulting symptoms noted.

sentences.en: The Immortal rubbed the injection spot with a grimace, stretched, and climbed inside the ring in the lowermost basement in the castle.

sentences.en: Morphine is recognized as one of the most useful drugs in the treatment of eclampsia, early injection often arresting the fits.

sentences.en: This may include antihistamine, adrenaline inhaler or adrenaline injection, depending on the severity of the reaction.

sentences.en: Patients with neutropenia may be treated with G-CSF (Neupogen), a protein given by injection that stimulates the body to produce more neutrophils.

sentences.en: Twenty-eight days after intrathymic injection, the mice were transplanted with an H-2K b -positive, fully vascularised cardiac allograft.
